pai-ensemble 的最小存檔單位是**一整個席次**（一次 `agent()` 呼叫）。席次做完才會在 journal 留下 `result`，`resumeFromRunId` 也只能讓做完的席次直接取快取。session 只要在席次跑到一半時中斷，那個席次做過的事全部作廢，接回之後要從頭再跑。

items.summary:
I'm building a web app with FastAPI + async/await Python backend. Users upload leaf photos via API and the server should return: 1) plant species, 2) disease label or "healthy".

Constraints:

  1. Generalization: Must handle multiple crops. Users can upload "any" plant leaf, not just tomato/corn. Target 15+ species.

  2. Server inference: Runs on GPU server, not mobile. Latency 1-2s is acceptable, so model size isn't a bottleneck.

items.title: [CI] Auto-Merge Controller fails on every scheduled run: `requests` is imported but not declared (ModuleNotFoundError)
items.summary:
## Summary
`scripts/auto_merge_controller.py` does `import requests`, but `requests` is not declared in `[project.dependencies]` or in the `dev` dependency group. The workflow installs only `uv sync --frozen --group dev`, so the script crashes on import every time it runs. In the lock file, `requests` is reachable only through `mkdocs-material` (docs group) and `jupyterlab-server` (notebooks group).
